label: GO step early in the episode (first ~10 trials, or up to ~25 after a rare transition)
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (98% of mass) and only early in the episode: rate is 23x baseline on trials 1-2, 9x on trials 3-9, and zero from trial 30 on. It never fires at D1 with a reward input or at D2 after S1. Within trials 10-25 it is mostly active when the previous transition was rare (prev_common lift 2x overall). Top activations are GO choices of a1 repeated after rare a1->S2 trials in early S1-good episodes. The simple (phase==GO)&(ep_trial<20) gets 96% of mass but precision 0.16. The recorded predicate (dev F1 0.39, mass recall 0.90) adds the rare-transition condition. Precision stays low because most early GO steps are inactive. Which early GO steps fire, and how strongly, also depends on start state / a1 choice and on |policy logit| (confident choices), which I did not fully capture. Uses only observed variables (episode position and the previous trial transition).
